title: Create a context and provide a value

slides.say: Context takes three steps: create it, provide it, and use it. Here are the first two.
Create it with create context, and export it so other files can use it. The only argument is the default value.
Then provide it. Wrap the children in the context, with a value prop. Any component inside that asks for level context gets this level.

slides.text: The prop must be called value.
slides.say: Remember: the prop is always called value.
